required_text_query: How can an auditor trace an excerpt to its origin and revision?

ranked_candidate_output.text: A provenance link binds each evidence passage to its originating record identifier, record version, and exact sentence span. The link lets a reviewer locate the passage used to justify a proposed concept definition.
A proposal-run receipt records the source and version of the model used to produce a concept proposal; it does not locate the evidence passage.
A constructed retrieval unit whose provenance link does not resolve to registered sources.
